_note: V29 -- the systematic value programme. SEPARATE from v27's ledger.
docs/V29_PREREGISTRATION.md is authoritative for humans; this file is
what qt.referee counts. Same machinery, different budget: v27's K=5
covers EVENT STUDIES, and spending its remainder on a portfolio model
would blur two programmes with different criteria.
K = 3, deliberately smaller than v27's 5. The reality-check correction
charges every declared slot, read or not, so three shots face an easier
bar. Budget is consumed by a READ, never by a declaration.
value_ebit_ev_v1 was declared 2026-09-05 after the operator fixed the
objective (risk-adjusted return), the metric, the universe and the
budget, and BEFORE any ratio was computed or any backtest run. The
scoring layer qt/scoring.py existed at declaration; the widened universe
and the fundamentals sweep did not.
THE RISK TIER IS A MULTIPLE-TESTING PROBLEM, not a feature. Three tiers
are three strategies. MODERATE is primary and is the only tier that can
pass. Promoting low or high later is a NEW declaration.
A REBUILD DOES NOT RESET THIS FILE.

params.objective: RISK-ADJUSTED RETURN. The operator's 'maximise profits with minimal risk' resolves to excess return per unit of risk, with an explicit drawdown condition so that 'minimal risk' is a bar the strategy must clear rather than an adjective attached afterwards. Fixed here because the same backtest ranks strategies differently under each reading of the phrase.
params.universe: point-in-time monthly membership, screened as of each date. ADV floor $50,000/day (LOWERED from $250,000), ADV ceiling $5,000,000/day, price >= $2.00, >= 200 bars.
params.why_the_adv_floor_moved: With $10,000 across 20 positions a position is $500; at 5% participation that needs $10,000 of daily volume. The old $250,000 floor was 25x what the capital requires and excluded exactly the names large capital cannot reach. $50,000 keeps 5x headroom and still sits far below institutional reach.
params.window: 2015-09-01 .. 2025-09-01, ten years (v27 used three, which was a Finnhub artefact; XBRL runs to 2011)
params.fundamentals: SEC XBRL keyed on `filed`, never on fiscal period `end`; flows from annual filings only; restatements resolved to the latest filing at or before each date (extract_fundamentals.py)
params.primary_value_metric: EBIT / enterprise value. ONE metric. No alternatives are tried, and trying one later is a new specification.
params.enterprise_value: market cap + long-term debt - cash. Long-term debt only, because that is what XBRL supplies reliably; short-term borrowings are missing, which understates EV and overstates the ratio for revolver-funded companies.
params.quality_gate: operating income > 0, book equity > 0, debt/equity <= 2.0. Applied BEFORE ranking.
params.risk_components: volatility (252d), max drawdown (252d), leverage, illiquidity (-log ADV), thin equity (1 - equity/assets). Each converted to a cross-sectional percentile at the rebalance date.
params.risk_composite: equal-weighted mean of available percentiles; at least 3 of 5 required, else NaN. Unknown risk must never sort into the low tier. Weights are DECLARED, not fitted -- fitting them would manufacture a score calibrated on this sample and nowhere else.
params.tiers: terciles of the day's scored set: low / moderate / high
params.primary_tier: MODERATE. Three tiers are THREE STRATEGIES; low and high are reported as description, cannot pass, and cannot be substituted. Promoting one later is a new declaration spending another slot.
params.rebalance: quarterly at month-end, entering the following session
params.costs: 75 bps round trip applied to turnover, INSIDE the criterion
params.delisting_return: TWO-TIER, fixed 2026-09-06. TIER 1: where the company keeps trading -- and most exchange delistings continue over the counter, 18 of 24 in probe run 33942599424 -- its ACTUAL prices are used and no assumption applies. Measuring beats assuming. TIER 2: where no price exists anywhere, -55% is charged ONCE on the first missing day and the sleeve earns zero thereafter. -55% is Shumway & Warther's NASDAQ performance-delisting figure, and this universe is mostly NASDAQ microcap. It is likely GENEROUS rather than conservative: the names with no data at all are the ones that truly vanished, which skews toward bankruptcy and deregistration. This parameter was recorded as EXPLICITLY UNMADE at declaration, so fixing it now -- before any return was computed and before the backtest was run -- completes the declaration rather than amending it. It does not move again.
params.measurement: calendar-time daily return series, Newey-West lag 10
params.order_of_operations: quality gate, THEN risk tier, THEN rank on value. Ranking first and filtering after produces a different portfolio and is not what this declares.
params.output_ledger: data/portfolios/value_ebit_ev_v1.csv -- NEVER any v27 events file or event_study ledger

result.prior: P(this specification clears all eight criteria) = 20-25%, midpoint 22.5%, accepted by the operator 2026-09-05 against the range proposed, BEFORE any ratio was computed. Above v27's 15% because the mechanism is structural rather than informational: value in names too small for institutional capital is not arbitraged away by publication, it is left alone because it cannot be traded at size. Not higher, because value is the most-published anomaly in finance and this is built entirely from free data. COUNTERSIGNED by the operator 2026-09-06 in docs/V29_PREREGISTRATION.md, before any ratio was computed and before the backtest existed. Every parameter and criterion is frozen from that date.

read.input_verified: input guard OK -- both declared inputs fingerprinted BEFORE dispatch and byte-identical to master. data/fundamentals/fundamentals_pit.csv 114,414 rows, sha256 6c9ee57112021fc767517b4bc7ad51bb49615326899838b958227e7c4a837eda; data/universe/v29_universe_pit.csv 152,006 rows, sha256 3b48776cc092aa910f31398c0c5355bde4c3641b2959764acbf78d9fa88773f7. Both windows 2015-09-30..2025-08-31. Checked BY HAND because the A7 content guard is specified but NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in run_value_backtest.py, which still tests only os.path.exists(). This is the 2026-09-07 hazard -- a stale panel of 111,398 rows / 2,225 names sat on master for a day and would have been read silently -- and it was closed for this read by manual verification, not by code.
read.universe: 152,006 eligible name-months, 120 month-ends, 40 quarterly rebalances 2015-09-30..2025-06-30. 16 panel rows dropped on an unusable ticker. 3,132 names priced + IWM; 3,087 of 3,133 returned usable history (5 failed downloads).

selection.ledger: data/portfolios/value_ebit_ev_v1.csv, 800 rows -- ARTIFACT ONLY, not committed. Harmless here: read mode re-derives the selection from PANEL and FUNDS before computing any return, so nothing downstream depends on the file persisting.

cleared: criterion 2 -- median 98 eligible names per rebalance >= 60 (min 58, max 113)
missed: criterion 6 -- max drawdown 50.9% is WORSE than IWM's 41.1% over the same window
criterion 7 -- stability UNDEFINED: first-third excess <= 0, which the declaration states is a MISS
read.criterion_8_not_evaluated: RECORDED AS A GAP, NOT AS A PASS. Criterion 8 declares WRC/SPA at p < alpha/K_declared = 0.0167 with unread slots charged. run_value_backtest.py contains no WRC, SPA or bootstrap code and the read log shows no such computation, so criterion 8 was NEVER COMPUTED. It does not change the verdict: four criteria miss independently and WRC can only ever make a result harder to pass, never easier. Stated here so the record does not read as seven-of-eight by omission.
read.reading: IT MADE MONEY AND THAT IS NOT THE SAME AS AN EDGE. 12.74%/yr against IWM's 10.03% is a +2.71% annual excess, and at t = 0.71 over 2,792 days that gap is indistinguishable from luck. The decisive number is criterion 6: a 50.9% maximum drawdown against the benchmark's 41.1%. The strategy took MORE risk than simply holding the index and did not reliably pay for it. Stability is the familiar shape -- the first third of the sample is <= 0, so the excess is concentrated in a later stretch rather than persistent, which is the same way form4_cluster_buy_v2 died. Three criteria clearing is not three-eighths of a pass; the four that missed are the four that decide whether anything is tradeable.
read.vs_prior: Operator prior was 20-25%, midpoint 22.5%, countersigned 2026-09-06 in docs/V29_PREREGISTRATION.md before any ratio was computed. Outcome is consistent with it. This was the highest prior the project ever recorded -- above v27's 15% because the mechanism was structural rather than informational -- and it still missed. Programme tally: v25 four of four pre-registered criteria failed, v27 two of two reads failed, V29 one of one read failed.
read.anti_deferral: This read STANDS. No bug found afterwards reopens it. The uncomputed criterion 8 is a gap in the implementation, not grounds to re-read: it could only have lowered the verdict, and the declaration's own clause is that a read specification cannot be re-read.

result.declaration_note: Declaring costs NOTHING against K -- qt.referee.k_used counts READS. K stays 0/3 until this is read. Nothing here is a commitment to read it.
criteria: N >= 1,000 trading days with a live book
at least 60 eligible names per tier at the median rebalance -- below that, 20 holdings is not a selection and the spec MISSES rather than being quietly resized
t >= 2.0 on the mean daily excess return, Newey-West lag 10
maximum drawdown no worse than IWM's over the same window
stability: final-third excess >= 50% of first-third; undefined if the first third is <= 0, which is a MISS
WRC/SPA at p < alpha/K_declared = 0.0167, unread slots charged
caveats_to_travel_with_any_number: SURVIVORSHIP IS CORRECTED ONLY FROM 2023. The delisted roster covers 2023-2026; this window starts 2015. Form 25 filings reach further back and the roster CAN be extended, but until it is, the first eight years carry the same upward bias every v27 read carried. THIS IS THE LARGEST KNOWN WEAKNESS IN THE SPECIFICATION.
LONG-TERM DEBT ONLY: short-term borrowings are missing from enterprise value, overstating EBIT/EV for revolver-funded companies
ANNUAL FLOWS: fundamentals are up to fifteen months stale by construction -- conservative, and it costs responsiveness

COSTS ARE AN ASSUMPTION, NOT A MEASUREMENT. 75 bps is a judgement about a band where real spreads vary enormously, and the result is sensitive to it. MEASURED 2026-09-06 (run 34050431641, Corwin-Schultz over the declared window): median 106-210 bps by ADV bucket, 1.4-2.8x the declared figure, against an estimator noise floor of ~60 bps. The parameter is SIGNED and does not move; if costs sink the read that is the pre-registration working.
NO SHORT LEG, so no market hedge; excess return over IWM is the only adjustment
VALUE UNDERPERFORMS FOR YEARS AT A STRETCH. A ten-year read can be negative while the strategy is sound and positive while it is not.
TWENTY ILLIQUID SMALL CAPS carry single-name risk that a backtest reports as volatility and a live account experiences as something worse.

params.hypothesis: SAME MECHANISM AS v1, TWO MECHANICAL CHANGES. Small-cap value: EBIT/EV over a point-in-time universe, long only, quarterly rebalance. v1 was READ 2026-11-08 and MISSED -- ann excess +2.71% at t 0.71, IR 0.205, max drawdown 50.9% against IWM's 41.1%, stability undefined on a non-positive first third. This specification changes TWO things and nothing else: flows become trailing-twelve-month instead of annual-only, and the portfolio holds 50 names instead of 20. NEITHER CHANGE CLAIMS NEW PREDICTIVE POWER. The first attacks staleness, which v1's own caveats record as up to fifteen months by construction. The second attacks criterion 6, which v1 missed on drawdown rather than on return.
params.universe: UNCHANGED from v1: data/universe/v29_universe_pit.csv, 152,006 eligible name-months, 120 month-ends, 2015-09-30..2025-08-31, point-in-time
params.value_metric: UNCHANGED: EBIT / enterprise value, where EV = market cap + long-term debt - cash
params.flows: ⚠️ CHANGE 1 OF 2. TRAILING TWELVE MONTHS, not annual-only. TTM is constructed as FY(n-1) + YTD(current period of year n) - YTD(same period of year n-1), which needs only year-to-date figures and never a derived discrete quarter. extract_fundamentals.py's own docstring names this as the correct refinement and the reason it was deferred: 'mixing a quarter into a series of years silently divides a ratio by four'. Where a TTM cannot be formed from facts VISIBLE at the as-of date, the metric is NULL and the name drops out of that rebalance -- it NEVER falls back to the annual figure, because a mixed series is the failure this change exists to avoid. Stocks (assets, equity, cash, debt) are instantaneous and are UNCHANGED from v1.
params.n_hold: ⚠️ CHANGE 2 OF 2. FIFTY names, equal weight, long only (v1: twenty). v1 concentrated into 20 illiquid small caps out of a median 98 eligible, and missed criterion 6 on a 50.9% drawdown against the benchmark's 41.1%. This is a PORTFOLIO CONSTRUCTION change and is expected to cut idiosyncratic risk; it is also expected to DILUTE the mean excess by reaching further down the value ranking. It may therefore fix criteria 5 and 6 while making criterion 4 harder. That trade is the point of the test.
params.order_of_operations: UNCHANGED: quality gate, THEN risk tier, THEN rank on value
params.quality_gate: UNCHANGED: drops unprofitable, no op_income, debt/equity > 2.0, negative or missing equity
params.tiers: UNCHANGED: terciles, primary tier MODERATE, low and high reported but cannot pass
params.rebalance: UNCHANGED: quarterly at month-end, entering the following session
params.costs: UNCHANGED: 75 bps round trip applied to turnover, INSIDE the criterion. NOT re-estimated for this spec even though the 2026-09-06 measurement found 106-210 bps. Holding it fixed keeps v1 and v2 comparable; raising it here would confound the two declared changes with a third.
params.benchmark: UNCHANGED: IWM. ⚠️ NOT the S&P 500. Any claim about beating SPY is a DIFFERENT specification against a different and substantially harder benchmark, and nothing in this read speaks to it.
params.delisting_return: UNCHANGED: two-tier, actual prices where the name keeps trading, -55% charged once where no price exists
params.measurement: UNCHANGED: calendar-time daily return series, Newey-West lag 10
params.funds: data/fundamentals/fundamentals_ttm.csv -- ⚠️ DOES NOT EXIST YET. A separate file from v1's fundamentals_pit.csv, which stays frozen and untouched so v1's read remains reproducible.

result.prior: P(value_ebit_ev_v2 clears every pre-registered bar) = 12%, signed Southpaw3234, 2026-11-08 -- recorded BEFORE dispatch, before any portfolio was formed on the TTM panel and before any return was computed. DELIBERATELY BELOW v1's 20-25%. The mechanism is identical to v1's and only the plumbing differs, so the 22.5% that already missed on four of eight criteria is a CEILING here, not a floor. FOR: TTM measurably halves flow staleness -- mean lag from as-of date to the operating-income period end falls 9.24 months to 3.93, with 88% of rows inside 2-4 months (run 42461866741) -- and fifty names attacks criterion 6 directly, which is where v1 missed, on a 50.9% drawdown against IWM's 41.1%. AGAINST: neither change claims new predictive power. Criterion 4 (t 0.71) is untouched by either and may WORSEN, because reaching from 20 names to 50 dilutes the mean excess. Criterion 2 gets harder rather than easier: v1 selected 20 from a median 98 eligible and a minimum of 58, and TTM refuses rather than falling back, so the pool thins. The 75 bps cost figure is still 1.4-2.8x below measured spreads and is held fixed for comparability. Survivorship is still uncorrected before 2023. TWO PARAMETERS MOVE AT ONCE, so a miss will not say which was wrong and one slot would remain to isolate it. NET: two of v1's four misses are plausibly addressed, one is untouched, one gets harder -- that is not a case for a prior above the one that already failed. THE REFEREE DOES NOT CHECK THIS FIELD (qt/referee.py:161 tests already-read, date order, terminal date and K budget, and nothing else), so this record, not the code, is what makes a read of v2 legitimate.
result.declaration_note: Declared 2026-11-08. DECLARING COSTS NOTHING AGAINST K: qt.referee.k_used counts READS. K stays 1/3 until this is read, leaving two slots. Nothing here is a commitment to read it. Parameters are fixed NOW, before fundamentals_ttm.csv exists, so the extractor cannot be tuned toward a nicer answer -- the sequence pead_8k_car_v3 followed.

t >= 2.0 on the mean daily excess return, Newey-West lag 10
maximum drawdown no worse than IWM's over the same window

availability_checks.ttm_extractor: NOT YET BUILT. data/fundamentals/fundamentals_ttm.csv does not exist. extract_fundamentals.py currently takes flows from annual filings only (annual_only=True) and collect_facts does not capture the period `start`, which TTM construction requires. Building it computes INPUTS only -- no ratio, no selection, no return -- exactly as the v1 panel did before v1 was read.
availability_checks.universe: YES -- unchanged and already landed: 152,006 name-months, 3,259 tickers, sha256 3b48776cc092aa910f31398c0c5355bde4c3641b2959764acbf78d9fa88773f7
availability_checks.eligible_names_at_50: UNKNOWN UNTIL A SELECT PASS. v1 measured a median of 98 eligible names in the moderate tier, min 58. Holding 50 of a median 98 is a far weaker selection than 20 of 98, and criterion 2's floor of 60 now bites harder: at the min-58 rebalance the spec would select 50 from 58. A select pass must be run and recorded before any read.

caveats_to_travel_with_any_number: ⚠️ TWO PARAMETERS MOVE AT ONCE, AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE COST. The registry's own discipline is ONE PARAMETER FAMILY, ONE TEST. Testing TTM flows and 50 names together means a MISS will not say which change was wrong, and only one slot would remain to isolate it. The operator chose both on 2026-11-08 with this stated. Recorded here so the limitation is in the record rather than discovered afterwards.
SURVIVORSHIP IS CORRECTED ONLY FROM 2023, unchanged from v1 and still the largest known weakness. The window starts 2015; the first eight years carry an upward bias.
COSTS ARE STILL AN ASSUMPTION AND ARE STILL UNDERSTATED. 75 bps declared against 106-210 bps measured. Held fixed for comparability with v1, which means this read inherits the same upward bias.
FIFTY NAMES RAISES TURNOVER COST EXPOSURE, not lowers it: more positions means more names entering and leaving at each rebalance, charged at a cost figure already known to be too low.

TTM IS LESS CONSERVATIVE THAN ANNUAL-ONLY. It is fresher, but it admits restated and interim figures that an annual-only series excluded. Fresher is not automatically better, and if v2 beats v1 the reason may be recency rather than accuracy.
LONG-TERM DEBT ONLY in enterprise value, unchanged from v1
NO SHORT LEG, so no market hedge; excess over IWM is the only adjustment
VALUE UNDERPERFORMS FOR YEARS AT A STRETCH. A ten-year read can be negative while the strategy is sound and positive while it is not.
